verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Let it be Jesus
The first name that I call

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Let it be Jesus
My song inside the storm
I'll never need another

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
For me, to live is Christ
For me, to live is Christ
God I breathe Your name
Above everything
Let it be, let it be Jesus

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Let it be Jesus
From the rising of the sun

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
Let it be Jesus
When all is said and done
I'll never need another, Jesus there's no other

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Should I ever be abandoned
Should I ever be acclaimed
Should I ever be surrounded by the fire and the flame

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
There's a name I will remember
There's a name I will proclaim

verse.name: b1c
verse.lines:
Let it be, let it be Jesus
Let it be, let it be Jesus
Let it be, let it be Jesus
